mechanism: Ginkgo biloba may potentiate anticoagulant effects and increase bleeding risk, while flecainide has a narrow therapeutic index; concurrent use requires monitoring for both bleeding complications and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor patient for signs of bleeding, maintain stable flecainide levels, and consider baseline and periodic INR/PT if patient is also on anticoagulants; counsel on ginkgo discontinuation before surgery.
